text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear opening claim and repeated stance","quality":"thesis clarity","description":"The essay states a recognizable position early and returns to it throughout, making the argument easier to follow."},{"evidence":"paragraphs on distractions, reliability, and human takeover","quality":"organization","description":"The essay is arranged into distinct sections that each develop one main point instead of staying at one level of generality."},{"evidence":"texting, eating, alcohol, and father example","quality":"specific support","description":"The essay uses several concrete examples to explain why human drivers are dangerous and why automation seems appealing."},{"evidence":"\"the cars aren't truly driverless\" and parking-lot takeover example","quality":"counterargument awareness","description":"The essay recognizes a serious limitation of the technology and uses it to qualify its own support for driverless cars."},{"evidence":"\"safety has to be the most important thing\" and closing reflection","quality":"conclusion","description":"The ending restates the writer’s overall judgment and brings the argument back to the central safety concern."}]}
